name: 🔍 Find the Needle!
desc:
Welcome to 🪡 Find the NEEDLE in 1,000,000 Hay
Will you manage to find the needle in the haystack?

[✅] How to Play:

👨‍🌾 Collect the hay from the pile
💰 Sell your hay for money to purchase upgrades! 
🪡 Find the needle in the haystack and win!

[❤️] Like the game and join the group for more updates!
